title: Wait, That's Real?
desc: Historical facts that sound completely made up but aren't

questions.q: Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing or the building of the Great Pyramid?
questions.a: The Moon landing — by about 500 years

questions.q: Oxford University started teaching before which famous empire even existed?
questions.a: The Aztec Empire (Oxford: ~1096 AD, Aztecs: ~1325 AD)

questions.q: The shortest war in history lasted roughly how long?
questions.a: 38 to 45 minutes — the Anglo-Zanzibar War of 1896

questions.q: Nintendo was founded in which century?
questions.a: The 19th — 1889, as a playing card company

questions.q: Woolly mammoths were still alive when which famous monument was being built?
questions.a: The Great Pyramid of Giza (mammoths survived until ~1650 BC on Wrangel Island)

questions.q: The fax machine was invented before or after the telephone?
questions.a: Before — the fax concept dates to 1843, the telephone to 1876

questions.q: The last execution by guillotine in France happened the same year as which film's release?
Samurai and cowboys existed at the same time — true or false?
questions.a: True — the samurai era ended in 1876, peak cowboy era was 1860s–1890s

questions.q: Albert Einstein was offered the presidency of which country?
Switzerland didn't give women the right to vote nationally until which year?
